item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00390","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C04","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 is the immediately preceding letter in the same exchange and supplies both the factual setup and the drafting framework for the child. Both address Chancellor Adenauer, respond to his appeal concerning food shortages in East Germany, describe a United States offer of food to the Soviet Government, and frame the action as relief for the East German population. The child updates C15 after the Soviet refusal and adapts its machinery by directing the Secretary of State and Director for Mutual Security to make the food available through another channel. C04 and C13 share some diplomatic-letter structure and humanitarian or assistance language, but neither approaches C15's concrete continuity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I share the regret expressed in your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], at the refusal of the Soviet Government to admit the food which the United States Government offered the East German population in response to your appeal of July 4.","parent_excerpt":"The receipt of your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], in which you outlined the serious situation existing in the Soviet Zone of Germany concerning the supply of food for the population... I am, therefore, anxious to respond affirmatively to your appeal","explanation":"The child expressly continues the exchange initiated by C15 and reuses its appeal-response framing."},{"child_excerpt":"the offer continues to stand and... the food continues to be available","parent_excerpt":"I have... instructed the American Charge d'Affaires in Moscow to offer the Soviet Government shipments of food for distribution to the population of East Germany.","explanation":"The child's operative premise is the food offer announced in C15, now maintained after rejection."},{"child_excerpt":"our joint purpose to aid the people of Eastern Germany... relieving the suffering of the people of Eastern Germany","parent_excerpt":"join you in aiding the people of East Germany... this effort on our part to relieve the plight of the people in East Germany","explanation":"Distinctively parallel language describes joint humanitarian aid and relief for the same population."}]}
